_comment: Canonical FALDA bearer tokens — shared by the HTTP API and the MCP endpoint when run via `falda serve` (see docs/API.md 'Authentication' and docs/MCP.md 'Auth model'). Copy to falda_tokens.json, replace the placeholder tokens (openssl rand -hex 24), and point FALDA_TOKENS at it. tenants[] is per-PROJECT, not per-container/agent — extend it every time you set up a new project against this token. Pool-admin routes (/pools/*, HTTP only) require a tenants: ["*"] token.

REPLACE_WITH_ANOTHER_openssl_rand_hex_24.label: fully-trusted internal caller (any tenant; required for /pools/*)
